name: unproducible-action-names
title: Action names a mode declares that nothing can produce
description: Measured: code-development's source.read/source.write and code-audit's repo.read/report.write appear only in their own files, are not in the capability registry and are not host tools, so they grant nothing; a capability call using them is refused by the registered check. The spec documents the mode-authorizes-versus-build-implements gap, so this is shared doctrine - the open question is whether a mode's own action names should be declared somewhere the loader resolves.
creator: aixi
